decisions.decision: DNS timeout: single global Dns.Timeout, default 5s, range 3s–30s
decisions.rationale: Simplest fix for hanging dns.Exchange(), matches RELIAB-01 requirement

decisions.decision: DNS timeout: per-resolver cached dns.Client (not per-query)
decisions.rationale: Better efficiency, one client per resolver address

decisions.decision: BGP context: store daemon lifecycle context in bgpSrv struct, pass to all GoBGP API calls
decisions.rationale: Simplest change — bgpSrv already has cancel field; just store ctx too

decisions.decision: BGP context: NewBgp accepts context.Context as first param from main.go
decisions.rationale: Threads daemon lifecycle context through to BGP service

next_action: Discuss remaining Phase 4 gray areas (BGP error logging, O(n) set difference), then plan Phase 4
